summary.zh: inventory 与 doctor 以独立目标 claude-desktop 只读 Claude Desktop 的 claude_desktop_config.json（须点名或用 --client all，不在默认客户端内）；doctor --client claude 对同名条目给建议级 shadowed-by 提示。
summary.en: inventory and doctor read Claude Desktop's claude_desktop_config.json read-only as the separate target claude-desktop (must be named or use --client all; not in the default client set); doctor --client claude adds an advisory shadowed-by hint for same-name entries.
